paper.title: Transverse-field Ising quench on a square Rydberg lattice

builder_params.spacing_note: derived from hx, omega and C6 by the builder, not fixed here

observable.description: lattice-averaged Rydberg occupation <n> vs quench duration

_notes: hx/J = 6 is the paramagnetic regime, where the FC1 noise model tracks hardware most closely — the reason this case was used to validate the pipeline. The lattice spacing is not a free parameter: the builder derives it from hx, omega and the live C6 so that the interaction sets the requested hx/J. The original submission scanned 75 time points in a single parametric batch; this spec uses 10 points because the pipeline submits one batch per scan point.
